more_screen_tagline: Shop profile, BakiPro, theme, and language.
more_identity_hint_free: New shops get premium features free for the first month — no purchase yet. Subscribe after that to keep recording instalments.
home_shop_currency_live: all amounts shown in this ledger
home_baki_default_meta: Healthy collection rhythm — keep receipts flowing.
customers_tagline: Track balances, gentle nudges, and receipts in one ledger.
sign_in_prompt: Sign in to view and manage customers.
suppliers_sign_in_prompt: Sign in to view and manage suppliers.
suppliers_tagline: What you owe on stock credit — quick taps for purchases and payments.
suppliers_subhint: What you owe on stock credit — purchases add debt, outgoing payments reduce it.
suppliers_empty: No suppliers yet. Tap + to add one.
delete_supplier_body: This removes the supplier and their ledger from your shop.
supplier_payable_balance_hint: Positive means you still owe this supplier.
supplier_purchase_saved_body: Share an A4 purchase / payable memo for this entry?
supplier_payment_saved_body: Send your supplier a WhatsApp message about this payment, or share the A4 voucher for your records.
snap_receipt_none: No amount was detected. Try a clearer photo.
snap_receipt_web_unavailable: Receipt capture isn’t available in the web preview. Use the mobile app.
receipt_gemini_not_configured: Receipt scan isn’t enabled on your server yet (set GEMINI_API_KEY on the API — same Gemini stack as Habimate).
customer_balance_link_hint: Read-only webpage your customer can open without the app.
customer_balance_link_created: New link copied & ready to share.
credit_invoice_body: Share an A4 invoice for this credit?
credit_invoice_body_whatsapp: Send your customer a WhatsApp update about this credit, or share an A4 invoice PDF.
contact_phone_required_whatsapp: Add this contact's mobile number first — WhatsApp needs a phone number to open their chat.
contact_suggestions_permission_denied: Contacts permission is needed to suggest names and numbers.
api_error_generic_server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
api_error_network_or_timeout: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
delete_customer_body: This permanently removes this customer and all their ledger entries from your shop.
customers_empty: No customers yet. Tap + to add one.
shop_profile_hint: Syncs with your BakiMate account — used on WhatsApp receipts and reminders.
shop_payment_instructions_hint: DuitNow QR, bank account, or payout link — pasted into receipts and WhatsApp nudges.
shop_duitnow_qr_hint: Upload your shop’s DuitNow QR. Show it to customers when they pay an installment, then tap Got paid.
shop_duitnow_qr_web_hint: Upload your DuitNow QR from the iOS or Android app (Profile).
shop_duitnow_qr_permission_denied: Photo access is needed to choose your QR image.
duitnow_qr_modal_hint: After the customer pays, close this and tap Got paid.
duitnow_qr_missing_body: Add your QR image in Profile so customers can scan it here.
more_nav_shop_settings_sub: Name, currency, payment details, DuitNow QR, quick labels
screen_shop_settings_subtitle: How your ledger appears — and how customers pay you
account_delete_section_body: Erase your shop ledger and login from here. Detailed policy wording may also be on bakimate.com. App subscriptions from Apple/Google are canceled in Store settings—not only by deleting here.
account_delete_confirm_body: Your shops, customers, suppliers, instalment history, QR uploads, and access tokens will be permanently removed from BakiMate. This cannot be undone.
account_delete_confirm_final_body: Confirm to wipe this account permanently from our servers.
more_sign_in_via_login: You need to sign in on the login screen (email & password, Google, or Apple).
login_headline: Sign in with email and password, or continue with Google or Apple.
login_try_again: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_register_subtitle: Use your email and a password so you can always recover access — even if you lose your Google account.
auth_password_min: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth_forgot_subtitle: We will email you a link to set a new password. Use the email you registered with — any provider is fine.
auth_reset_subtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
auth_reset_missing_params: This reset link is incomplete. Open the link from your latest reset email, or request a new reset from the sign-in screen.
auth_verify_subtitle: We sent a verification link. Open it on this device (or any device), then come back here and tap "I've verified".
auth_verify_resend: Didn’t get the email? Resend link
auth_verify_still_waiting: Not verified yet — open the link in the email we sent, then try again.
auth_verify_check_failed: Could not check status. Try again.
auth_verify_resend_failed: Could not resend right now. Try again shortly.
auth_verify_no_email_hint: Go back to Create account and sign up again so we know which address to verify.
google_no_id_token: Google did not return an ID token. Check your OAuth client configuration.
google_no_id_token_android: Google did not return an ID token. On Android release builds: in Google Cloud Console add this app’s signing SHA‑1 to the Android OAuth client (same package as your build), enable “Custom URI scheme” for that client, then reinstall the app. Redirect uses com.ihabimate.bakimate:/oauthredirect.
apple_no_identity_token: Apple did not return an identity token.
oauth_not_configured_body: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID, EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID (Android), EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID to your environment, then rebuild the app.
oauth_not_ready_yet: Sign-in client is still loading — try again in a moment.
google_env_hint: Configure Google OAuth in Expo env (see .env.example) and rebuild. The Laravel API must list the same client IDs in GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS.
google_proxy_hint: Expo Go: add this exact URL under Google Web client → Authorized redirect URIs: https://auth.expo.io/@ihabimate/bakimate (or set EXPO_PUBLIC_EXPO_PROXY_PATH). Prefer a dev build for production-like OAuth.
apple_ios_only_hint: Sign in with Apple is available on the iPhone and iPad app build.
paywall_body: New accounts include the first month on us — no subscription yet. Once that ends, subscribe here to keep recording credits and instalments.
paywall_native_only: Subscriptions are available in the iOS and Android apps.
paywall_missing_api_key: Add revenueCatIos / revenueCatAndroid in app.json extra, or set them in EAS env.
paywall_no_offerings: RevenueCat did not return any offerings. Create an Offering with packages linked to App Store subscriptions, mark it current, check the public SDK key and bundle ID, then rebuild.
paywall_asc_products_not_loading: Your RevenueCat Offering is reachable, but the App Store has not returned any subscription products on this install (StoreKit lists are empty — common when IAP status is Ready to Submit, Paid Apps/IAP contracts are incomplete, IAPs aren’t submitted with an app version yet, or Sandbox isn’t signed in). Finish setup in App Store Connect, wait for propagation, then try a physical device with Settings → App Store → Sandbox Account.
paywall_configure_failed: Could not start subscriptions. Check your network and RevenueCat SDK key, then try again.
paywall_dev_storekit_launch_hint: If you ran this install with expo run:ios, Xcode does not attach the local StoreKit file — offerings often stay empty on Simulator. Start Metro (`npm run start:localhost`), then open the workspace (`npm run ios:xcode`) and run with Product → Run. Or test on an iPhone with a Sandbox Apple ID.
paywall_rc_offerings_404: RevenueCat couldn’t load plans (HTTP 404). Use the public SDK key for this store: Apple `appl_…` on iOS, Play `goog_…` on Android (RevenueCat → API keys). The bundle ID/package must match this app, and you need at least one Offering with packages. Rebuild after changing keys.
paywall_invalid_receipt_explainer: Apple completed the test purchase, but RevenueCat could not validate the receipt yet. Xcode’s StoreKit Configuration uses local receipts—to finish end-to-end, upload your StoreKit testing public certificate in RevenueCat’s iOS app settings, or test with a Sandbox Apple ID on a scheme that does not attach the .storekit file.
paywall_store_problem_ios_sandbox_explai: Apple declined the Sandbox purchase (often Authentication Failed — AMS 100 / password reuse not allowed). Sign out Sandbox in Settings (search Sandbox; it’s usually under App Store), then sign in with a Sandbox tester from App Store Connect only; create a new tester email if prompts block password reuse; accept pending invitations/terms for that Sandbox account on the web first. Prefer a physical iPhone if Simulator stays flaky. In .env set EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_OFFERING_ID to your offering slug (e.g. bakimate_pro), not RevenueCat internal ids beginning with ofrng.
paywall_price_pending_store: Price unavailable — open checkout or wait for App Store pricing to sync.
membership_trial_blurb: Full access while you learn the app — no charge until the trial ends. Eligible new subscribers only (see Apple / Google checkout for details).
membership_ref_usd_monthly: Pricing target ~{{price}}/month (your store may show local currency).
membership_ref_usd_3mo: Pricing target ~{{price}} / 3 months (your store may show local currency).
membership_ref_usd_6mo: Pricing target ~{{price}} / 6 months (your store may show local currency).
membership_ref_usd_year: Pricing target ~{{price}} / year (your store may show local currency).
membership_paywall_footer: Prices and trial eligibility are finalized at checkout. Configure products in App Store Connect & Google Play with the same durations; link them in RevenueCat.
paywall_legal_auto_renew: Payment is charged to your Apple ID or Google Play account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your device subscription settings after purchase.
more_legal_privacy_terms_hint: Required for App Store subscriptions — opens in your browser.
pro_subscription_body: You can record credits (Gave) and payments (Got) from each customer screen.
subscription_expires_active: Your premium access on this account is active until {{date}}.
subscription_expires_expired: Premium on this account ended on {{date}}. Renew below to keep recording.
subscription_expires_unknown: We don't have an expiry date for your account yet.
theme_follow_device_hint: Default follows your device. Choose Light or Dark to override.
shop_load_failed: Could not load shop from server.
quick_gave_hint: Sold on instalment — adds to their debt
quick_got_hint: Recorded a payment toward their balance
voice_mic_hint: Tap the mic — speak briefly, then tap again to finish.
next_due_pick: When is the next installment due?
no_due_selected: Tap a preset or skip — defaults to +7 days when you opened this sheet.
saved_offline_body: We could not reach the API. We will send this transaction automatically when you're back online.
saved_offline_customer_body: This customer is saved on your phone. We will create them on your account automatically when you're back online.
customer_partial_cache_hint: Limited offline view from your last customer list. Reconnect to load promises, recent activity, and documents.
supplier_partial_cache_hint: Limited offline view from your last supplier list. Reconnect to load full details and recent transactions.
payment_saved_body: Send a WhatsApp receipt to your customer, or share an A4 PDF for your files. Every credit and payment appears in the ledger PDF on the customer screen.
wa_receipt_qr_hint: QR (DuitNow / etc.) is saved in the shop profile — reply if you need a screenshot.
wa_credit_thanks: Thank you — please keep this message for your records.
wa_supplier_payment_footer: Thanks — this matches our ledger record.
wa_install_intro: Hi, this is a friendly reminder about your installment.
wa_install_closing: Please reply when you can make the next payment. Thank you!
wa_nudge_body: Friendly reminder from our shop ledger: your balance still needs attention this week.
wa_nudge_qr_hint: I also keep a QR in my BakiMate shop profile — say if you want it sent.
wa_nudge_closing: Please reply once you've settled. Thank you!
wa_smart_body: Just checking in from our shop ledger — the balance showing for you is still:
wa_smart_followup: Whenever you can settle, it really helps us keep stock moving. Thank you for your trust and support.
wa_smart_qr_hint: QR is saved in my BakiMate profile — I can WhatsApp it on request.
wa_summary_thanks: Thank you — please settle when convenient.
no_balance_hint: No udhaar on this ledger line — reminders are hidden.
dash_priority_sub: Top overdue or soon-due installments at a glance.
dash_priority_empty: Nobody needs an urgent chase right now.
pending_sync_banner: {{count}} payment(s) still syncing — balance may update shortly.
insights_subtitle: Cash collected, who owes most, gentle nudges — without the clutter.
insights_projection_teaser: Ballpark collections next week — about {{amount}} (guess from recent receipts, not a promise).
insights_week_totals_line: Week so far · collected {{collected}} · new udhaar {{credit}}.
insights_cashflow_foot_short: Green bars = collected. Red = new credit you logged.
insights_shop_health_teaser: Quiet stock on the street: roughly {{amount}} without fresh movement — expand for speed & star payers.
insights_weekly_nudges_hint_short: Balances with weak recent payments — tap WhatsApp for a short, polite follow-up.
insights_quick_item_pulse_sub_short: Quick labels you sell on credit — and a rough read of how much total udhaar looks tied to each.
insights_quick_item_row_line: Credit this month {{credit}} · rough udhaar share {{est}}
insights_pulse_sub: Cash-flow health — not only who owes.
insights_pulse_dead_hint: Outstanding balance with no ledger activity for {{days}}+ days.
insights_pulse_velocity_na: No comparison yet (last week had no collections).
insights_pulse_loyalist_hint: Customers with the most separate payment records.
insights_pulse_loyalist_empty: Once people pay often, they’ll appear here.
promise_card_hint: When someone says they'll pay by a date, log it — we remind you.
reliability_stars_hint: {{count}} reliability ★ earned when promises are kept.
insights_projection_body: Based on payments recorded in the last 28 days, you might collect about {{amount}} next week. Use it as a guide, not a promise.
insights_cashflow_title: This week: cash in vs credit out
insights_cashflow_foot: Each day shows green (payments in) and red (new credit) for this calendar week.
insights_top_debtors_empty: Nobody owes you right now — great work.
insights_weekly_nudges_hint: Outstanding balance with no qualifying payment recently — tap WhatsApp for a polite follow-up.
insights_weekly_nudges_empty: Nobody matches the nudge rules this week.
customer_tx_pdf_a11y: Download A4 PDF for this entry
customer_tx_delete_body: This removes it from the ledger and updates the customer’s balance.
customer_pdf_hint: Share or print — requires an active subscription.
customer_settlement_locked_hint: Available when outstanding balance is exactly zero.
customer_pdf_web_unavailable: PDF export is available in the iOS/Android app builds.
customer_settlement_not_ready: Settlement PDF is available only after the balance reaches zero.
weekly_review_notif_body: Open Insights — chase slow payers and review this week’s cash flow.
shop_quick_items_hint: Shown as chips when recording “Gave credit” — helps spot which stock is stuck out on loan.
shop_primary_currency_hint: Pick from the list or enter another ISO code. Amounts are stored in minor units (÷100 → major).
shop_reference_currency_hint: Optional: show approximate amounts in another currency. Enter foreign units equal to **1 unit** of your ledger currency.
insights_credit_mix_hint: How much udhaar you extended by quick-item tag.
insights_credit_mix_empty: Tag credits with quick items from Profile to unlock this breakdown.
insights_quick_item_pulse_sub: Credit you gave this month on each tag — and roughly how much of today’s udhaar is tied to those sales.
insights_quick_item_pulse_foot_method: Udhaar estimate splits each debtor’s balance by lifetime credit mix per tag — a planning hint, not exact stock costing.
insights_monthly_pdf_hint: Download transactions for {{month}} — share with a partner or your accountant.
insights_monthly_pdf_web: PDF download is available in the mobile app build.
